cases.action: dispatch LINE, then replace the document identity the snapshot holds
capture, then change the document revision

note: K1/K2 were corrected after the existing chrome_actions tests showed the stronger rule was wrong: switching the active view must NOT kill a running command (the command keeps the view and plane it captured). A command dies when its document identity changes, when the view it started in is gone, or when the revision moved.
